title: vigna lasiocarpa
intro: Vigna lasiocarpa, commonly known as the hairy bean or hairy jackbean, is a perennial legume native to tropical Asia and Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help lower blood sugar levels and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Vigna lasiocarpa include its role in stimulating digestion and as a diuretic, helping to relieve fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
